mapper.select: SELECT id, name, base_url, api_key, model_name, completions_path, created_at, updated_at FROM model_config ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_config (name, base_url, api_key, model_name, completions_path) VALUES (#{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{modelName}, #{completionsPath})
mapper.update: UPDATE model_config SET name = #{name}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, api_key = #{apiKey}, model_name = #{modelName}, completions_path = #{completionsPath}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
